let rec loop (i : Nat) (minVal maxVal : Int) : Int :=
    if i < a.size then
      let x := a[i]!
      let newMin := if x < minVal then x else minVal
      let newMax := if x > maxVal then x else maxVal
      loop (i + 1) newMin newMax
    else
      maxVal - minVal
  loop 1 (a[0]!) (a[0]!)
